units.source_text: 在京都车站前，太吉郎正要乘上这辆花电车，有一个中年女人有意躲在他的后头，像是忍住笑的样子。

en.t: In front of Kyoto Station, just as Takichiro was about to board this decorated streetcar, a middle-aged woman deliberately hid behind him, as if holding back laughter.

units.source_text: 太吉郎也算是个有明治派头的人。

en.t: Takichiro, too, could be considered a man with something of a Meiji air about him.
